detail.longDescription: Java records and pattern matching made reading nested immutable data easy. Writing it is still a copy constructor cascade: about 25 lines to change one street name. Optics fix that. Define the path once, compose it, reuse it. I wrote up why records need them, with lens, prism and traversal examples. https:// blog.scottlogic.com/2026/01/09 /java-the-immutability-gap.html # Java # FunctionalProgramming # Immutability # JavaRecords # OpenSource
